V21 path: 'Derived Maintenance Net Filter' (name=DerivedMaintenanceNetFilter, stepType=AdvancedListFilter, criteria ItemIsDerived__std Equals true, resultIncluded=false) scopes ListContainer9 (ListGroup seq17) whose seq-2 child 'Derived Pricing Formula' = IF(QuoteTypeText=Renewal, NetUnitPrice, tier(AttributeValue: Premier .30/Standard .20/Professional .20 else 0) x base(Base_Price__c||Pre_Partner_Price__c||InputUnitPrice)) -> outputs NetUnitPrice. The filter is the SEPARATION mechanism: ItemIsDerived materializes from PBE.IsDerived (verified: RNM-PIAMBK USD PBE=true, NRPS-PIAP=false), so derived maint lines enter the derived-net computation while non-derived license is excluded; both nets then sum into the net aggregate (Aggregate Price -> TotalPrice/GrandTotal/Subtotal/ALE). Category buckets Total_Software/Services/Subscription are null (correct: Fortra_Product_Type is 'Perpetual'/'New Maintenance', not Software/Services/Subscription which key those conditional aggregates per project_quote_pricing_rollups). The two $0 lines on the 8-derived control are documented missing-MTD/platinum config-gated cases (J-02), not a filter defect - the filter still routed them; they lack tier data. defect_provenance SC-3346 (derived-pricing build): the non-renewal derived-maintenance net-filter/aggregation path works correctly in V21; the SC-3346 unresolved residual is the RENEWAL COLA-commit on derived-maint (distinct branch step 26 'COLA Uplift Net on Renewal', tracked by sibling rows J-04/J-10), NOT this non-renewal net-filter aggregation.
